limitations: Inverse optimization can exploit forward-surrogate approximation errors.
Out-of-distribution inverse iterates may invalidate the surrogate.
name: Inverse Problems with Learned Forward Surrogates
summary: Use a trained forward surrogate, potentially a neural operator, inside a conventional inversion or Bayesian inference algorithm.
core_idea: Replace repeated expensive physical forward solves with a learned approximation while retaining explicit data-misfit or posterior inference.
innovation: Separates amortized forward-model training from repeated inverse inference, with new surrogate-error and bias considerations.
